rows.en: More importantly, what about the Maganac Corps...?
More importantly, what's goin' on with the Maganac Corps?
Heavyarms and the others are rescuing them right now.
Hey, how long do you plan to hang around a place like this?
The "Gaia Cannon" is our valuable equipment.
We can't let you have it!
How dare you act like a bunch of petty thieves!? I'm gonna teach you a real lesson!?
The "Gaia Cannon" is our valuable equipment.
We can't let you have it!
How dare you act like a bunch of petty thieves!?
You mean to fight us, Gundam against Gundam?
You're wrong! You are no Gundam!!
Damn it!! We're Gundams too, for cryin' out loud...!!
Next time we meet... we will defeat you, without fail!!
Arche Gundam! A mercenary, as you can see.
The bigwigs asked me to do something about you lot.
Seems they've got no more use for brats like you!!
You have my sympathy! You poor things!!
GN particles sure are pretty, huh!? Ain't that right, little lady!!
Sorry, but I've got a bonus riding on this.
Huh? If it ain't the 00 brat!!
Still haven't kicked the bucket since landing in this world? Not bad!!
Too bad, but today's job is over.
I'll deal with you lot another time! See ya!!
Well, well, if it isn't the heroes!
Too bad, but today's job is over.
I'll deal with you lot another time! See ya!!
More importantly, what about the Maganac Corps?
More importantly, what about the Maganac Corps?

notes.note: 0245 speaker labels here are shifted/unreliable (0.110 says Sandrock, 0.111 Den-O). Order inferred from the parallel 0246 block (0.76-0.104): 0.105-0.106 OOO, 0.107-0.108 Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros voice), 0.109 Sandrock, 0.110-0.118 = 00, Wing Zero, Nu, Zeta, Mebius, Zero, W, OOO, Den-O, 0.119 Ankh. Wording is the same either way.
Polite form (Mebius, matching his polite 'Yes, somehow' earlier); rendered as 'I see.' without trailing ellipsis to mark the more composed reply. Same for 0.117 (OOO).

Legacy mis-decode: first-person plural pronoun garbled; read as 'our' via clean twin 0245#0.17. Source term in corner brackets kept in double quotes. 0246 uses 'equipment' where 0245 says 'weapon'; followed the 0246 wording.
Zwei, manic tone; source ends both sentences with !? and that is kept.
Eins to 00: 'Gundams fighting each other?' rendered with 'us' restored.
Singular second person (kisama) in source, so 'You are no Gundam' aimed at Eins.
Legacy mis-decode: first kanji garbled; read as 'next (time)' via 0245#0.48. Subject 'we' restored (Eins speaking for Team Trinity); 'I' would also fit.
Ali al-Saachez catchphrase 'tokoro ga gicchon' rendered 'Not so fast!!' (common English fan rendering). Not in glossary style.catchphrases; speaker '???' is Arche Gundam before reveal.
Arche finishing off Zwei; 'itchimaina' = 'go on / be gone', rendered 'Off you go!!!' to keep the jeering tone.
No speaker recovered; Arche Gundam (same line labelled at 0.71).
No speaker recovered; one more party member's reaction (likely OOO, per the 0.5-0.12 roster).
No speaker recovered; silence (Arche leaving / party), 0245#0.88 labels it Arche Gundam.
Legacy mis-decode: 'daijoubu' first kanji garbled; read via 0245#0.90.
Reply continues into story_036 (Nu Gundam's follow-up question).

report: 80/80 rows. Legacy rows 0246#0.2/0.33/0.37/0.51/0.75 had mis-decoded kanji, resolved via clean 0245 twins. 0245#0.105-0.119 speakers inferred from parallel 0246 block (labels shifted). Ali's catchphrase 0246#0.34 rendered 'Not so fast!!' (not in glossary). 0246#0.33 subject 'we' restored (could be 'I').
